title: Replace Tailwind CDN default theme with custom design system
description: index.html loads Tailwind via CDN with the untouched default 'primary' sky-blue palette and rounded-lg/shadow-lg cards - the stock look every AI-scaffolded dashboard defaults to. static/css/styles.css exists but is empty and unused. Write a real stylesheet: dark, high-contrast, technical-instrument aesthetic (this is a research/imaging tool, not a SaaS product), one deliberate accent color, monospace for numeric/data values. Drop the Tailwind CDN script entirely.

title: Redesign layout: viewer as hero, settings as compact technical panel
description: Current layout gives the 3D MRI viewer and the Settings & Actions button-stack equal visual weight in a 2-col grid. The viewer is the actual product; settings should be a dense, secondary technical panel (compact form controls, grouped by function) not a column of full-width blue buttons.

title: Restyle form controls and buttons to match new system
description: All inputs/buttons currently use Tailwind's default utility classes (px-4 py-2 bg-primary-500 rounded-md etc, repeated inline on every element). Once the design system exists, consolidate into real CSS classes and restyle to match the instrument aesthetic, not default form-input look.

title: Update favicon to match new visual identity
description: Current favicon is an inline emoji-brain SVG data URI. Low priority polish once the rest of the visual identity is settled.

title: Remove dead fileHandling.js (duplicate of main.js upload logic)
description: static/js/fileHandling.js (140 lines) duplicates the file-upload/drag-drop logic already in main.js and is never imported anywhere. Found while redesigning the UI - separate repo-hygiene cleanup, not touched as part of the visual redesign.

title: Fix mobile horizontal overflow (toolbar, slider row, dataset params)
description: At 390px viewport (iPhone), toolbar (mode-switch + tool icons + Clear button), sliders-row (3-col), and settings-grid-2 (2-col) all overflow horizontally past the viewport edge, causing the whole page to scroll sideways. Confirmed via screenshot at 390x844.

title: Fix header tag wrapping awkwardly on mobile
description: hdr-right tag text ('MSc research build') wraps into 3 cramped lines next to the theme toggle at narrow widths. Low priority polish.

title: Train on larger/combined datasets beyond the initial <2GB demo model
description: First demo model (train_classifier.py) trains on Falah/Alzheimer_MRI alone (~28MB, 6400 images, 4-class) to get a working public inference demo shipped quickly - hit 95.4% test accuracy on CPU in ~2min. Follow-up: source and combine additional open Alzheimer's MRI datasets (still no gated/ADNI-style data - stay auto-downloadable) to push past the <2GB starting point and improve real accuracy. GPU note: this machine has a GTX 1080Ti but pip-installed tensorflow[and-cuda]'s RPATH doesn't resolve the venv's bundled CUDA libs automatically - set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the nvidia/*/lib dirs under .venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/nvidia before training to actually use it (matters for larger runs, didn't matter for the small first pass).

title: Harden and deploy public demo (resource caps, inference-only)
description: Once train_classifier.py produces models/alzheimer_classifier.keras: wire a new inference-only Flask endpoint (no training triggers exposed publicly), add Docker --memory/--cpus caps sized for the shared VPS (2 vCPU, 3.73GB RAM, no swap, ~2.86GB free, 8 other containers already running with no memory limits of their own), remove/disable the Process Image/Tabular/Prepare Data buttons from the public build, then configure VPS_HOST/VPS_USER/VPS_SSH_KEY secrets and flip the DEPLOY_ENABLED repo variable.
